description: Current gas prices for one Quebec city: station count, minimum and average ¢/L for regular, premium and diesel, and the five cheapest stations for regular (name, address, price). Use it for "how much is gas in X", "cheapest gas in X" and comparing stations or brands within a city. Takes a city slug, not a region and not a place outside Quebec; an unknown slug returns an error, after which resolve it with search_locations.

city_slug.description: City slug: lowercase, no accents, hyphens (e.g. "montreal", "quebec", "trois-rivieres", "saint-jean-sur-richelieu"). Use search_locations or list_cities when unsure.

name: get_city_prices
title: Get a city's current fuel prices
